help.title: BrainLink guide
help.intro: A quick guide to where your notes live, how AI access works, and what to do when an optional feature is unavailable.
help.vaultsBody: Add each Obsidian or Markdown folder you want BrainLink to use. A vault stays on this computer unless you set up its own sync. You can choose one or more vaults for each AI connection in Twin Profiles.
help.twinsBody: A Twin Profile describes whose information it contains, which vaults belong to it, what kinds of memory are available, and which actions are allowed. Keep personal and company vaults in their intended profiles.
help.agentsBody: An agent such as Anna or John is a role stored in BrainLink, not a separate AI app. Say “Connect to Anna” or “Connect to John” in a connected AI. If it says a role is missing, start a new AI session so it loads BrainLink’s current tools, then check the connection in Setup.
help.permissionsBody: For each AI and Twin Profile, choose the vault and allowed actions. Read permission lets the AI search and open notes. Write permission lets it save notes when a tool supports direct writes; proposal-only actions ask you to review the draft first.
help.searchBody: Use Ask for a question across the available vaults, or Browse notes in Your brain to find a note by title. BrainLink search continues to work when local reranking is turned off or unavailable.
help.graphBody: Choose a vault to view its notes and links. Click a folder color to show just that group; click it again to restore all groups. Click a note to open its detail window. Browse notes are sorted newest first and grouped by the first two folder levels.
help.connectBody: Choose an AI app in Connect, assign it to the right Twin Profile, and pick its vaults and permissions. After changing a connection, fully quit and reopen that AI app and start a new chat so it loads the updated tools.
help.sourcesBody: Sources can be reviewed before they become notes. Check the selected vault, source folder and review settings in Sources. BrainLink keeps source text in the chosen local vault unless you separately configure syncing.
help.sessionsBody: Sessions can show work history and help prepare a closeout note. Session sharing is controlled separately in Sessions. Review the suggested destination and draft before saving unless you explicitly asked BrainLink to close the loop.
help.backupBody: Backups and vault sync are separate. Choose a backup folder and schedule in Backup, and check its latest status. Syncing a vault to another service may make those files available on that service too.
help.rerankBody: This is optional. “Could not connect: fetch failed” means BrainLink could not reach a compatible reranking service at the shown local address. Start that service if you use it, or turn reranking off; normal BrainLink search still works.
help.privacyBody: Private vaults and notes marked private are kept out of shared views. Excluded folders are not read or searched by BrainLink. Review each connection’s Twin Profile permissions before relying on an AI to access a vault.

brief.title: Daily brief
brief.hint: Create a summary of recent changes and open work from one chosen vault. Private vaults are handled only in this local app; the brief stays on this computer and is not written into the vault.
brief.enabled: Run a brief each day in the background
brief.saved: Daily brief saved. It runs while BrainLink is open; enable launch at sign-in to run after you log in.
brief.disabled: Daily briefs turned off. You can still run one manually.
backup.title: Private backups
backup.hint: Backups include private notes. They are not encrypted unless you turn on Encrypt backup contents. Saving while enabled creates and verifies the first backup.

backup.confirmRecoveryKey: Paste the recovery key to confirm you saved it
backup.encryptHint: Only new backups are encrypted; old copies stay unchanged. Keep the recovery key somewhere safe away from this computer. Without it, encrypted backups cannot be restored. BrainLink stores a local copy for scheduled backups.

startup.title: Keep scheduled work running
startup.enabled: Start BrainLink quietly when I sign in
startup.hint: Scheduled scans, briefs, backups, and sync run while BrainLink is open. Turn this on to start it quietly after you sign in. Clicking the app icon still opens Setup. Supports Windows, macOS, and desktop Linux.
startup.enabledToast: BrainLink will start quietly when you sign in.
startup.disabledToast: Background startup is off. Scheduled backups run only while BrainLink is open.
twinProfiles.title: Twin profile status
twinProfiles.hint: Create and manage Personal, Organisation, and Client Twin access. Named AI agents can use only the vaults, actions, and memory types you approve.
twinProfiles.createTitle: Create a Personal, Organisation, or Client Twin
twinProfiles.createHint: Choose the vaults, AI agents, and memory types for this profile. You can create a profile without assigning an AI agent yet.
twinProfiles.name: Profile name
twinProfiles.identityHint: After creation, the Twin type and owner stay fixed so saved sessions and handoffs keep the same privacy boundary.
twinProfiles.chooseVaults: Choose vaults and the maximum access this profile may grant. Full read and write access applies only to the selected AI agents and vaults. Note writes require confirmation and never overwrite existing notes.
twinProfiles.chooseAgents: Optional: select an AI agent to choose its vaults and actions separately.
twinProfiles.readProposePresetHint: Applies only to the selected AI agents and vaults; review the choices before saving.
twinProfiles.readProposePresetSelect: Select at least one AI agent and one vault first.
twinProfiles.readProposePresetApplied: Read and propose access is ready for review. Nothing has been saved yet.
twinProfiles.chooseMemory: Memory types available to these agents (notes are not manually sorted into these types).
twinProfiles.memoryCeilingHint: Set the maximum memory this Twin allows. Then choose a smaller scope for each AI agent.
twinProfiles.applyMemoryToAgents: Match selected AIs to the Twin memory limit
twinProfiles.applyMemoryToAgentsHint: Copies the allowed memory types to the selected AIs. Review before saving; nothing is saved yet.
twinProfiles.applyMemoryToAgentsSelect: Select at least one AI agent first.
twinProfiles.applyMemoryToAgentsDone: Selected AIs now match the Twin memory limit. Review before saving.
twinProfiles.privacyHint: New notes are private by default and include source details. Session reading stays off unless selected. A selected AI can save notes only in vaults with Full read and write; saves require confirmation and never overwrite notes.
twinProfiles.needNameVault: Enter a profile name and choose at least one vault.
twinProfiles.needAgentVault: For each selected AI, choose a vault and an allowed action. Saving notes requires Full read and write for that vault.
twinProfiles.noAgents: No unassigned named AI agents yet. Create a profile now, then add an agent when you are ready.
twinProfiles.confirmCreate: Create {name} for these vaults: {vaults}. Assign these AI agents: {agents}. Enabled memory types: {memory}. Selected agents will receive only the checked access. Continue?
twinProfiles.firstProfileWarning: Creating the first profile changes how AI access is scoped. Existing connections may lose access until they are assigned permissions and reconnected. Review every connection after this change.
twinProfiles.confirmUpdate: Update {name} for these vaults: {vaults}. Agent actions: {agents}. Enabled memory types: {memory}. Agents allowed to read sessions can also read older sessions assigned to this Twin. This replaces current access; its GitHub assignment stays in place. Continue?
twinProfiles.empty: No Twin profiles are declared yet.
twinProfiles.memoryDescription.working: Current tasks, handoffs, and open items.
twinProfiles.memoryDescription.semantic: Saved facts, notes, links, and graph data.
twinProfiles.memoryDescription.procedura: Role instructions, operating manuals, runbooks, and Skills; requires procedural access.
twinProfiles.limits: These limits apply only to named agent tokens assigned to a profile. Session access requires an explicit grant and matching profile ownership; closeouts require approval. rsi.title: Improve BrainLink
rsi.hint: Capture ideas, evidence and experiments. Saving a proposal never changes live behavior.

rsi.weekly.hint: Run 20 fictional questions against BrainLink’s built-in sample vault. No connected vault or AI model is used; this measures retrieval, not answer quality.

rsi.observe.firstRunDue: Automatic review is on; the first review is due now.
rsi.observe.lastFailed: Last review could not be saved: {when}
rsi.observe.hint: Checks local tool outcomes, graph review choices, and rough response-size estimates. It can compare content-free search results separately for each Twin. Optional link-health checks read one selected vault locally and save counts only. A scheduled signal can create a review-only proposal; it never changes code, search ranking, notes, or permissions.
rsi.observe.vaultHealthEnabled: Also compare link health in one vault
rsi.observe.vaultHealthHint: If enabled, BrainLink reads the selected vault on this computer and saves only counts, not note names or text. It checks link structure and typed-graph references, not whether filing or relationships are correct.
rsi.observe.vaultHealthSummary: Link health in {vault}: {broken} broken links · {orphans} unlinked notes · {duplicates} duplicate titles · {unresolvedRelations} unresolved typed links · {duplicateIds} duplicate entity IDs · trend: {state}. Counts cannot prove a relationship is correct.

rsi.observe.findings: {count} area(s) may need review. No product or permission changes were made.
rsi.observe.noFindings: No strong failure signal found. Small samples remain unknown.

rsi.promotionCommitHint: Must match the clean test run below and exist in the local BrainLink Git repository. BrainLink does not check GitHub or CI.
rsi.testSetHashHint: Copy this from the eligible test run using its review button.
rsi.rollback.title: Record a reviewed rollback
rsi.rollback.hint: First revert and check the code. The restored commit must exist in the local BrainLink Git repository. This saves evidence only; BrainLink does not change Git or run the rollback.
rsi.rollback.confirm: Confirm the code has already been reverted and checked. BrainLink will only record this receipt.
rsi.monitor.title: Review after release
rsi.monitor.hint: Record a human-checked result for the exact accepted commit. BrainLink stores the receipt; it does not run production checks or roll code back.
rsi.localPrivacy: Stored locally in BrainLink app data. Do not enter customer details, private notes, or secrets.
rsi.duplicates: These existing ideas look similar. Save this as a separate proposal anyway?
rsi.discovery.title: Research discovery (opt-in)
rsi.discovery.hint: When turned on, BrainLink checks selected public sources daily by default. A result must match both a search topic and one of your problems. It is saved only as a Discovered proposal; nothing is tested or adopted without your review.
rsi.discovery.starterHint: Fills topics and sources only. Review them, then turn on and save to start research.
rsi.discovery.starterLoaded: Starter settings filled. Review them before saving.
rsi.discovery.topics: Search topics sent to selected sources (one per line, up to 5)
rsi.discovery.signals: Problems you want solved, kept on this computer (one per line, up to 8)
rsi.discovery.refreshExisting: Also recheck old saved sources (up to 3 each run)
rsi.discovery.privacy: Normally only search topics leave this computer. If old-source checks are enabled, up to three exact public citation IDs from BrainLink discovery records are also sent to the same selected services per run. Problem statements, notes, sessions, and credentials stay local. Do not enter customer details or secrets. Scheduled checks run only while BrainLink is running. Turn on quiet startup below to resume them after sign-in; closing BrainLink pauses them until its next launch. Crossref abstracts may be copyrighted; Semantic Scholar abstracts and GitHub descriptions and search results are unreviewed public data.
rsi.discovery.backgroundHint: Scheduled research runs only while BrainLink is open. Turn on quiet startup to resume it after you sign in; closing BrainLink pauses it until next launch.

replay.hint: When a search finds nothing good, BrainLink can keep the question so you can try it again after improving your notes. The questions stay on this computer, private vaults are never recorded, and you can clear the list at any time.
